scientific_integrity: Complete analytical proof and separately reproducible rational/numerical diagnostics are provided. Uniform-law modified-wavenumber coincidences are credited; published-equivalence checks do not establish historical uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Exact noiseless, single-frequency planar rotation; isotropic population data, independent offset and unrestricted linear matrices. Results do not address noisy or finite-sample learning, nonlinear flows, or multiple frequencies. The classical fourth-order compact derivative symbol already appears in previous literature; originality is restricted to the complete arbitrary-law velocity-regression, residual, and moment-based tradeoff classification.
title: Exact two-moment phase diagram for chord-velocity learning on planar rotations
